items.title: The cohomology of the cone attached to a fibre product of algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms X -> B and Y -> B of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the object E of the fibre product equation has vanishing cohomology in degrees 0 and -1, and at a geometric point of X x_B Y the degree -2 cohomology is Tor_1^R(A,B) tensor_{A tensor_R B} C with R, A, B, C the respective etale local rings (source lines 4825-4838). The proof uses that the formation of the cotangent complex commutes with stalks and pullbacks, that C is a henselization of A tensor_R B, and that the localization results of the chapter give L_{C/R} = L_{A tensor_R B/R} tensor C, so that the stalk of E is the cone of the map L_{A/R} tensor C -> L_{A tensor_R B/R} tensor C; the statement is then reduced to the ring case.
